text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Super Creek is a horse girl whose 'excellence' and ability are known both inside and outside the academy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I took 1st place~.
Even if it was just a mock race, I'm so happy♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Aside from her ability, she is also widely known for one other major trait—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Phew, it sure is hot today~... Oh?
Trainer, you're sweating so much. Let me wipe that off for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reached into my pocket to grab a handkerchief... but
there was nothing there. Looks like I forgot to bring one...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, don't worry. Leave it to me...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There now, hold still.
Good boy, good boy♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, I ended up getting pampered again...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
All... done! That should feel much fresher♪
Make sure to double-check for your handkerchief and tissues before heading out, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her attentive nature is certainly a wonderful virtue. But as a trainer,
I can't let myself be babied forever. After all—

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Second place, huh... That was close. But your time has definitely improved.
Let's keep up this momentum!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir! It's all thanks to your guidance, Trainer!
I'll keep counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...A trainer is supposed to be someone a horsegirl can rely on.
choice_data_list: I can't just keep letting her baby me...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Did you say something?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...? 
Come now, it's about time for lunch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even during lunch, Super Creek keeps on pampering me.
But, to change my relationship with her—
choice_data_list: Is there anything you want me to do for you?
Is there anything you want me to do?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let's see... I want you, Trainer, to have a well-balanced diet,
and eat plenty of food.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...I'm happiest when I can take care of someone like this, and see them smile and feel energized.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So you don't need to worry about it.
If anything, please let me pamper you even more♪
choice_data_list: Don't you ever want to be pampered yourself?
Don't you ever want to be pampered?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let me see.
Even looking back on my childhood, nothing really comes to mind.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
When I was little and at the daycare my parents ran,
they always said I was 'such an easy child to take care of.'

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: In fact, they said I used to help my parents comfort the other children my age whenever they started crying.
choice_data_list: Why are you so good at taking care of others...?
Why are you so good at taking care of others...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Why...? Hmm, now that you ask me that directly,
it's a bit hard to say...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Watching the children who came to our place...
and seeing them grow, I realized something.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
At first, everyone can't do anything on their own.
They need the help of those around them.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's their parents, teachers, or friends...
they grow up little by little while being helped by someone.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If I could be the one to help them with that, well...
wouldn't that be just... absolutely wonderful?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Helping someone grow... that really resonates with my own feelings
as a Trainer toward my Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To help them fulfill their wish of 'wanting to be faster than anyone else'—
there is no greater wish than to see that come true.
choice_data_list: I feel the exact same way.
I feel the same way too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You feel the same way, Trainer...?
Fufu, that makes me so happy somehow.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I see, so that's why you wanted me to ask something of you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now, what should I ask for... Hmm...
Ah, I just thought of something.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... would you let me...
sew on that loose button on your shirt?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I noticed earlier that it was about to fall off,
and I just haven't been able to stop thinking about it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Come now, take it off for me.
Don't worry~, it'll only take a moment.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, this is a favor I'm asking of you.
Come on, hand it over♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the day I finally graduate from Super Creek's doting
is still a long, long way off...
